item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 03/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring very hot weather to southern China today and tomorrow. The area of low pressure now over the seas near Luzon is bringing unsettled weather to the region. It may develop into a tropical cyclone gradually in the next couple of days, but its movement remains uncertain. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the next few days, and edge closer to the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. There will be a few showers and thunderstorms over the region.
